prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop application composition for Bakiano / Madrid Delivery Sim by combining the two supplied UI references. The user approved this combination: "watching all in the map is super important, but the agent view is the protagonist." Reference A contributes an always-visible large network map and compact top navigation. Reference B contributes the prominent agent roster and linked execution evidence. Do not copy invented sample metrics as product facts.

Render an edge-to-edge real web screen, no browser frame, 1440×960 proportions. Top navigation: Delivery, Restaurants, Inventory, Health, Traces, Architecture, Madrid. Compact title 'Delivery operations', subtitle 'Synthetic city · local rules', Start simulation and Configure. Compact KPI strip: Orders/min, On-time, Cost / delivery, p95 decision. Use em dashes with 'No run yet' where unavailable. Main area: substantial agents workspace on the LEFT, slightly wider dark city map on the RIGHT, both visible without scrolling. Agents filters for role and status, names and technical IDs, state pills, task, throughput histories, six readable rows. Selected Lucia Mora is delivering basket B-042; other roles include dispatcher, inventory, fulfillment and judge. The map shows the ENTIRE synthetic grid network, muted roads/buildings, small distinct shop/home/courier icons and selected teal route; compact legend and map controls. Beneath BOTH panes a selected-agent evidence strip shows state, current task, last decision, Open trace. An order table starts below.

Preserve calm dense Linear-quality graphite surfaces, restrained teal accent, IBM Plex Sans and Mono, hairline dividers, no gradients, no decorative hero, no nested cards. Label displayed run content 'Illustrative synthetic session'. All regions are semantic controls, tables or data-driven maps.
approval: User requested merging A and B: watching all in the map is super important, but the agent view is the protagonist.
